Liu Diaz — Creative Operator, Strategist & Builder.

Quick Bio

Liu Diaz is the founder and lead creative strategist behind SoupDesignedit (@soupdesignedit), bringing 4+ years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, brand architecture, and full-stack media production. Specializing in logo systems, high-converting landing pages, organic-to-lead marketing funnels, retention-paced video editing, and AI-native animation workflows, Liu builds cohesive brand engines engineered to turn attention into measurable growth.

Founder Memo

Why Brands Choose SoupDesignedit

MEMO // SD-01

Most agencies hand you pretty graphics that don't sell, or slow timelines that kill your momentum. I built SoupDesignedit to eliminate both.

Over the last four years, I've built e-commerce storefronts and consumer brands from zero, engineered high-converting launch funnels for service businesses and digital creators like @kinetix.studio, @velocecustoms, and @apexroastco, and directed original AI-animated series and viral short-form campaigns across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

When you work with me, you get one unified creative engine: custom logos, conversion-engineered websites, retention-paced Reels & TikToks, and AI-assisted animations—executed through repeatable 48-Hour Content Sprint systems. No fluff, no bottlenecks—just undeniable creative built to win.
